question: India accounts for approximately what proportion of global tuberculosis cases annually, making it the country with the highest TB burden?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. 10% would rank India among high-burden countries but not the highest. India alone accounts for more than one-quarter of global cases.
Correct. India carries approximately 26% of the global TB burden, reporting around 2.8 million new cases each year — the highest of any country.
Incorrect. 40% is an overestimate. India accounts for roughly 26% of global cases.
Incorrect. 15% underestimates India's burden. The correct figure is approximately 26% of all global TB cases.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the epidemiology section. India accounts for ~26% of global TB cases — the single highest national share worldwide.
